_readme: Submit these templates to Meta WhatsApp Business Manager for approval. Variables use {{1}}, {{2}} etc. The URL button must be configured with a variable URL token ({{1}}). The backend supplies an HTTPS redirect (https://<your-domain>/pay/<token>) that opens the customer's UPI app chooser; Meta does not allow upi:// URLs directly in template buttons.
